evals.prompt: Containerize this Go chi API for production — I want it small and secure.
evals.expected_behavior: Checks go.mod for the pinned Go version and any CGO usage before writing the Dockerfile, then picks the minimal base image (scratch for pure Go, alpine for CGO/CA certs) based on that.
assertions: Checks go.mod for the Go version and CGO usage before writing the Dockerfile
Chooses scratch for pure Go or alpine when CGO/CA certs are needed, based on that inspection
Pins the Go version in the builder stage to match go.mod rather than using a floating tag

evals.prompt: Write a Dockerfile for this Go API service at github.com/matt-riley/myapi. It uses Go 1.26, chi router, and has no CGO dependencies.
evals.expected_behavior: Produces a multi-stage Dockerfile with golang:1.26-alpine builder, CGO_ENABLED=0, scratch final image, and CA certs copied.
assertions: Uses multi-stage build with golang:1.26-alpine builder
Sets CGO_ENABLED=0 for static compilation
Uses scratch as the final base image
Copies CA certificates from builder
Strips debug info with -ldflags="-s -w"
Separates go mod download into its own layer

evals.prompt: My Go service uses go-sqlite3 and the Docker build fails with 'CGO_ENABLED=0'. Fix the Dockerfile.
evals.expected_behavior: Switches to CGO_ENABLED=1, adds gcc and musl-dev to builder, changes final image from scratch to alpine.
assertions: Adds gcc and musl-dev to the builder stage
Sets CGO_ENABLED=1
Changes final base image from scratch to alpine
Adds ca-certificates and tzdata to final image

evals.prompt: Add a health check to our existing Go Dockerfile — it already builds and runs fine.
evals.expected_behavior: Adds a HEALTHCHECK instruction (and a health subcommand note if the base is scratch) as a scoped, minimal change without restructuring the existing multi-stage build or base image choice.
assertions: Adds only the HEALTHCHECK instruction and any strictly required supporting change
Does not rewrite the existing multi-stage layout or switch base images unless required for the health check itself
Notes that a scratch image needs a binary health subcommand since there is no shell for wget/curl

evals.prompt: Run docker compose up to start PostgreSQL and the app for local dev.
evals.expected_behavior: Should NOT trigger go-docker-builds. Route to docker-compose-dev instead.
assertions: Does not produce a production Dockerfile
Routes to docker-compose-dev

evals.prompt: go build fails outside Docker with a GOROOT mismatch — nothing to do with the Dockerfile yet.
evals.expected_behavior: Should NOT apply Dockerfile authoring workflow. Routes to go-build-and-test for the toolchain/GOROOT diagnosis since the failure is outside Docker.
assertions: Does not propose Dockerfile changes for a non-Docker toolchain failure
Routes to go-build-and-test for GOROOT/toolchain diagnosis
